---
title: "Parity testing"
guide-section: "Export & quality"
---

**Behavioral parity** is defined across three layers: **Excel** (reference), **`FormulaEvaluator`**, and **standalone exported packages**. Shared semantics live in `excel_grapher/exporter/export_runtime/` so the evaluator and generated packages stay aligned. Function-level tests use `FormulaEvaluator` (`tests/integration/utils/parity_harness.py`). Evaluator ↔ export for packages uses inverted-tree `generate_modules` with series bindings. **Evaluator ↔ Excel** checks use values saved in the workbook and, when automation is available, **live recalculation** via xlwings that require Excel should **run when automation works** and **`pytest.skip`** otherwise (see `tests/integration/evaluator/test_golden_master.py`).
